text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Year Japan Cup... This 
outcome... this convergence is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――"Known." However――there are 
fluctuations.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A little more "DROC." Back then, Neo 
Universe was—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—4th place. The winner was... Tap Dance 
City.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It really can't be avoided, huh... As 
expected, Neo Universe is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, the place I came to with Neo 
Universe was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The rooftop of Tracen Academy. It was the 
place where I first met Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to talk about what comes 
after the "GATE". Even if I can't 
"swallow" it down—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Requesting "FELT". Neo Universe's 
permanent "field of vision"."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just what on earth is visible in those 
eyes of Neo Universe's?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe—cannot see the future.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I told Zenno Rob Roy this as well. The 
future is 'invisible'—to everyone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She called it "predicting the future," but 
it still doesn't seem to be true 
precognition.
choice_data_list:
So you're saying it's just a "guess," 
right?

So you're saying it's just a "guess," 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is not precognition, but rather 
intellect— inferring from what is visible. 
That much should be obvious...
choice_data_list: “推測”してるってことだよな？
“推測”してるってことだよね？

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative. Nor is it conjecture.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The future cannot be seen. But to Neo 
Universe..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: There is something that can be "observed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Speculation" and "observation" are vastly 
different. Namely—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the future isn't visible, it means 
"something else" is. Then what is it 
that's in sight...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: What Neo Universe sees is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —A parallel universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes, an alternate universe. In that place—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"There is another Neo Universe. 'DBER' or 
'MUTX'..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe is connected, infinitely.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Among them—I can see the closest "one."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was such an outlandish tale. If you 
were told out of the blue, no one would 
believe it. And yet...
choice_data_list: もうひとりの……ネオユニヴァース……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe and I had built up a 
foundation. A foundation of trust. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw it with my own eyes. Neo Universe 
accurately predicted things she had no 
possible way of knowing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A parallel universe. If, by some slim 
chance, I could witness a world where 
similar things unfold...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Everything makes sense now.
choice_data_list: So you can... see it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's believe in it. And what matters most 
is what lies ahead.
choice_data_list: もし見えるんだとしたら――
choice_data_list_en: If you really can see it—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: From here on... After the "GATE"...
choice_data_list: 君は今後……どうなるんだ？
貴方は今後……どうなるの？
choice_data_list_en: What will become of you... from now on?
What will become of you... going forward?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe knows. What happened to the 
self in the other universe.
choice_data_list_en: Right, that's what I'm talking about.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The Neo Universe of another universe...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I entered the Tenno Sho (Spring). And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“—She suffered a crushing defeat. 
Finishing in 10th place.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
After the race, various signals 
crisscross. "Fluke," "breaking point," 
"lofted"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"And after that, the 'me' in another 
universe undergoes 'NIZR.' In other 
words—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――"Gone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a perplexing choice of words. 
Retirement would have made sense. But the 
word Neo Universe used was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――"Gone." The meaning was hazy, words 
leaving me unable to grasp what had just 
happened.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe disappears. Un-'observable,' 
and what happened cannot be seen."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"That outcome"... is not desired. Neo 
Universe wants to "STRK". Beyond the 
"GATE"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to exist... I don't want to 
"disappear"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if it had vanished entirely without a 
trace... If that were true, it was only 
natural to desperately wish to break 
through it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Only half a year left until the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). We have to uncover the truth 
before then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling a chill run down my spine, I 
decided that, for now, we should talk 
about what to do next.
choice_data_list: Where to for your next race...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, Neo Universe had chosen not 
to avoid expected trajectories, but to 
push through them with greater strength.
choice_data_list_en: Where to for your next race...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to avoid disappearing, it 
seems better to stay on this path and 
strive for better results."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
After the Japan Cup, the path the Neo 
Universe of another universe walked was—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The Senior Class Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Osaka Hai." A 2000m GⅠ held in March 
of next year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The distance is ideal, too. Even without 
any prior information, this is the race I 
would have chosen.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "Osaka Hai." That was—the choice made 
by the other "us." And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The final happy memory... with Trainer.
